# EuroDigital

> EuroDigital (Euro Digital Technologies LLC) is a digital marketing and AI automation company based in Abu Dhabi, UAE.

EuroDigital helps businesses generate leads, automate marketing and sales workflows, improve customer engagement, build websites, deploy CRM systems, and implement AI-powered business automation.

## Core Services

- [Digital Marketing & AI Business Promotion](https://www.eurodigi.ai/services/ai-business-promotion)
- [AI Business Automation](https://www.eurodigi.ai/services/ai-business-automation)
- [AI Voice Agents](https://www.eurodigi.ai/services/ai-agent-talk-time)
- [AI Chatbots](https://www.eurodigi.ai/services/ai-automated-chatbot)
- [AI Add-on Services](https://www.eurodigi.ai/services/ai-addon-services)
- [Industry-specific AI](https://www.eurodigi.ai/services/industry-specific)

## Products

- [AI Website Builder](https://www.eurodigi.ai/products/website-builder)
- [ED-CRM](https://www.eurodigi.ai/products/edcrm)
- [Emotion AI](https://www.eurodigi.ai/products/emotionai)
